findings.title: Shared screenshot pairs mostly show another PR's change
findings.evidence: bodies-round2/bambu-05.md, bambu-gtk-integration.md and wx-02.md all embed the same pair as bambu-08.md: stock-sidebar-cards-before.png -> native-sidebar-cards-purge-swatches.png (blob 91aa62a0). Viewed both images. The visible difference is bambu-08's change: equal-width printer and plate cards, the full 'Textured PEI Plate' label and the moved help icon. The 'before' image is also cropped to the printer row only. bambu-03.md and bambu-project-startup.md embed an identical pair (project-metadata-before.png -> native-project-initial-gallery.png), and neither says which of the two fixes the before-state needs. The shared caption only says 'Images show an earlier combined Linux build of this series.'
findings.trigger: An upstream reviewer reads bambu-05, wx-02 or the GTK integration PR on its own.
findings.outcome: They credit the card layout change to a DPI or wx change that does not cause it, or they cannot tell what the PR changes visually. That works against the 'easy to review' goal and the screenshots requirement.
findings.smallest_fix: Before upstream, capture PR-specific images where practical. For wx-02 and the GTK integration: the same Linux window at Xft.dpi 144, opt-in off vs on. For bambu-05: a view whose icons or fonts change without bambu-08. Until then, change the alt text and add one clause in those three bodies, for example 'No isolated screenshot yet; this pair mainly shows the card change from #8.' In bambu-03 and project-startup, say in one clause which cause each fixes (slow online lookup vs page opened before the app answered).
findings.verification: Look at the images next to each PR's diff. Each visible difference should come from that PR, or the body should say it does not.
findings.kind: new (evidence clarity); not a code defect

findings.title: Every FromDIP/ToDIP call now does a system-option lookup, including in apps that have not opted in
findings.evidence: d54f3313 src/gtk/window.cpp wxGTKDIPScale(): 'if ( wxSystemOptions::GetOptionInt("gtk.window.font-dpi-scaling") != 1 ) return 1;' runs on every FromDIP/ToDIP call. Previously, include/wx/window.h made these an inline identity on GTK3. abb54269 src/common/sysopt.cpp GetOption(): builds a wxString from the literal and does a case-insensitive linear Index(). When the option is unset (the default for every other GTK3 app), it also copies the name, runs two Replace() calls, calls GetAppName() and makes up to two wxGetenv() calls with concatenated names. BambuStudio calls FromDIP throughout layout and paint code. The API itself (one wxSystemOptions flag) follows existing wx idiom (gtk.control.disable-sensitivity-fix, gtk.desktop) and is not over-designed. Only the per-call lookup cost is new.
findings.trigger: Any GTK3 app linked against this wx calling FromDIP in a paint or layout loop.
findings.outcome: Several heap allocations and environment lookups per conversion that used to cost nothing. Nothing visibly breaks. Not measured; this conclusion comes from reading the code only.
findings.smallest_fix: Read the option once, for example 'static const bool s_fontDPIScaling = wxSystemOptions::GetOptionInt("gtk.window.font-dpi-scaling") == 1;' inside wxGTKDIPScale. This matches the documented rule 'Set before creating windows and do not change it afterwards'. Caveat: a FromDIP(sz, NULL) call before the app sets the option would lock it off. Bambu sets it on the first line of OnInit, so Bambu is unaffected. If wx maintainers prefer the current live read, keep it and mention the cost in the commit message.
findings.verification: Rerun the existing default-off, zero and on probes, each in a separate process (with a cached value, switching the option inside one process no longer takes effect). Rebuild the Linux pair.
findings.kind: new minor efficiency; design choice for the wx owner

findings.title: A few review-process and jargon phrases remain in the short bodies
findings.evidence: bambu-ams-zoom.md: 'Keep the accepted 2× limit' (an upstream reader does not know who accepted it); 'Native Linux resize fixtures and browser-source checks pass'. bambu-gtk-integration.md: 'Pin wx to the reviewed revision'. wx-02.md: 'existing identity conversion', 'Keep coordinate sentinels and integer bounds intact', 'C++98 checks'. bambu-09.md: 'native-API source checks'. bambu-10.md: 'The camera-only helper passes an isolated native Linux resize test'. Lengths are fine (61-88 words).
findings.trigger: The user's 'avoid overly technical language' goal.
findings.outcome: Small amounts of internal process language. Not wrong.
findings.smallest_fix: Examples: 'Limit AMS zoom to 2×'; 'Pin wx to a specific revision'; wx-02: 'By default sizes are unchanged, so apps that have not fixed double scaling are unaffected' and drop the sentinel sentence; 'Tested on Linux with a resize test app'. Fable owns the final wording.

findings.title: State plainly that the wx pin changes no Windows/macOS code
findings.evidence: git diff --stat abb54269 0f2037fa: include/wx/window.h (the only compiled change adds '&& !defined(__WXGTK3__)' to the inline guard, which does not change other ports), interface/wx/*.h (docs only), src/gtk/control.cpp (inside #ifdef __WXGTK3__), src/gtk/window.cpp (inside #ifdef __WXGTK3__). abb54269 is the current bambulab/wxWidgets master (repositories.json). Today the pin builds the same Windows/macOS wx code as the old 'GIT_TAG master'. It does stop later bambulab master changes from flowing in automatically. The app opt-in in e77253cd is guarded by '#if defined(__WXGTK3__) && wxUSE_SYSTEM_OPTIONS'. With an older wx the option does nothing (SetOption stores an unused value), so older builds keep their previous conversion.
findings.trigger: The user's OS-compatibility question, and an upstream reviewer seeing a dependency-wide pin.
findings.outcome: The body says only 'Windows/macOS integration remains untested'. That is true but leaves out the more useful fact that no Windows/macOS wx code changes.
findings.smallest_fix: One clause: 'The pinned wx matches current bambulab/wxWidgets master plus two GTK3-only commits, so Windows/macOS compile the same wx code (not yet built here).'
findings.verification: Rerun the diff --stat above; body reread.
